name: Xinyi Energy Holdings Limited
summary: Xinyi Energy Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the operations and management of solar and wind farms in the People's Republic of China. The company acquires, owns, and manages a portfolio of utility scale ground-mounted solar farm projects. It is also involved in the sale of electricity; and provision of big data, intelligent management, and video surveillance platforms, as well as drone inspection and automatic cleaning systems. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Wuhu, the People's Republic of China. Xinyi Energy Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Xinyi Solar Holdings Limited.
